formal_baseline: original LLaDA low-confidence, 128 steps, generation length 256, block length 32

development_evidence.v8_humaneval_0_9: bidirectional block 3/10, symmetric_fast 4/10, original LLaDA 4/10; one recovery and two losses
development_evidence.insight: All observed harmful conservative switches had less than one cumulative nat of actual commit-path evidence per existing generation block, while the sole recovery exceeded that already-established structural gate. Final block verification alone is not sufficient.

method.horizontal: The same fixed fast and conservative attention schedules create two complete trajectories.
method.longitudinal_path: The conservative trajectory must exceed fast by more than one cumulative nat per existing 32-token block in committed-token evidence along its actual denoising path.
method.longitudinal_counterfactual: The bidirectional block full-draft verifier must independently assign higher common alternative likelihood to the conservative trajectory.
method.selection: Switch only when both longitudinal tests agree; otherwise retain symmetric_fast. Whole trajectories only, with fast tie-break.
method.new_hyperparameters: none; the one-nat-per-existing-block gate is inherited unchanged from the prior block-evidence parent
method.extra_nfe: at most one batched two-direction forward per active generation block

development.deterministic_replay: HumanEval/0-9 candidates and block scores from the completed v8 run, followed by same official execution path
development.next_gpu_gate: Fresh HumanEval/0-31; require method > symmetric_fast, method >= original LLaDA, and at least one method-only recovery

formal_unseen.status: No correctness labels, outputs, selector scores, or candidate evidence inspected
formal_unseen.gate: strictly beat symmetric_fast and original LLaDA with at least one method-only recovery

promotion: Only unseen HumanEval success reaches Prism-aligned MATH-50, then sampled MBPP/GSM.
